content.rendered:
The last time Bruce had a milestone birthday, Philadelphia’s WXPN-FM (shout-out to my all-time favorite radio station) organized an on-air 60th Birthday Bash tribute.

The event featured an array of wonderful artists, but their song choices largely hewed to the usual candidates. There were several “Streets of Philadelphia” covers, a couple versions of “Born to Run,” and of course a few “I’m on Fire” renditions.

But singer/songwriter Lizanne Knott went deep that night, turning in a lovely cover of “Stolen Car.”

More wistful than haunted, Lizanne’s arrangement makes for a very different song than Bruce’s original. But isn’t that what a cover should be?

Lizanne finally released her cover of “Stolen Car” years later on her 2016 album, Excellent Day.

© September 20, 2019

excerpt.rendered: Lizanne Knott celebrated Bruce’s 60th birthday by recording a wistful cover of deep cut “Stolen Car.”

jetpack-related-posts.title: Trace Jory: Stolen Car
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Trace Jory was introduced to "Stolen Car" through X Ambassador's creative cover, but he drew on Bruce's original arrangement for his own rendition.

jetpack-related-posts.title: X Ambassadors: Stolen Car
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: From March 2018, the X Ambassadors prove their fandom by delivering a fantastic, moody cover of Bruce's "Stolen Car."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Little White Lies
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "Little White Lies" is a thematic analogue to "Stolen Car" and forerunner to "Brilliant Disguise" -- a fascinating outtake from The River sessions.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Chevrolet Deluxe
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce seems to have spent a lot of time working on "Chevrolet Deluxe," but in the end, he sold it for parts.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Dave Alvin: Seeds
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: As far as I'm concerned, Dave Alvin's cover of "Seeds" is the definitive version of the song.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Alison Mosshart: State Trooper
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: During the dark heart of the pandemic, Alison Mosshart recorded a chilling cover of the dark heart of Nebraska.
